_comment: Row 452 (successor of parked row 124, FR-A6.2). Re-run from a detached clone: toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row452_a62_breadth.json --work DETACHED_CLONE. EVERY ANCHOR IS A BARE def PREFIX -- no numeric literal, no quoted string, no True/False/None, no `=` -- because row357 refuses a new value-bearing anchor that no producer re-derives, and it was right to refuse this battery's first draft: the M1 anchor then matched the script_srcs list comprehension, whose matched source text carries `"url"`, `".js"` and `+=`. The replacement text carries the shape; the anchor carries only a name. M1 is the one worth reading twice. All five captures carry dom_log_len 0, so the brand pack registered through ensure_registered is the ONLY reason a player family is claimed at all -- archiveorg_item reads jwplayer and ted_talks reads hlsjs purely from network-derived script srcs. Never registering it makes every family read unknown, which is precisely the silent rot this row exists to make impossible, and the sibling transform-control spec proves that catch is an assertion failure and not an import break.
subject: the A6.2 breadth claim rests on real captures: the evidence population is the five 2026-08-29 captures and cannot silently shrink, the genuineness predicate really does reject a synthetic fixture, and each pinned recognizer verdict is reproduced from the real capture rather than assumed

mutants.label: M1 the brand pack is never registered, so a DOM-less real capture claims no player family at all
M2 the genuineness predicate fails open, so a synthetic fixture passes as a real capture
M3 the evidence population reads empty, so a deleted or never-landed corpus passes as complete
M4 verdict_pin returns nothing, so no recognizer verdict is actually compared to its real-capture pin
